label: VERIFIED
extraction: dmux Workflows ECC helper orchestrate-worktrees.js details. Creates branch-backed git worktree per worker. Optionally overlays selected seedPaths from main checkout into each worker worktree. Writes per-worker task.md, handoff.md, status.md files under .orchestration/<session>/. Starts tmux session with one pane per worker. Launches each worker command in its own pane. Leaves main pane free for orchestrator. seedPaths used when workers need access to dirty or untracked local files not yet part of HEAD (local orchestration scripts, draft plans, docs). Example plan.json includes sessionName, baseRef, launcherCommand, workers array with name/task. Complementary tools: dmux (tmux pane management), Superset (terminal IDE for 10+ parallel agents), Claude Code Task tool (in-process subagent spawning), Codex multi-agent (built-in agent roles).
